locations.name: St. George Street (North)
locations.brief_description: You are on the north end of St. George Street, near the library.
locations.long_description: To your West stands the massive, concrete form of Robarts Library. To your East stands the building of New college. The street continues South toward the heart of campus.

locations.name: St. George Street (Middle)
locations.brief_description: You are in the middle of St. George Street.
locations.long_description: You are standing at the busy intersection in the middle of campus. To the West is the path leading to New College. You can see the street extending both North and South.

locations.name: St. George Street (South)
locations.brief_description: You are on the south end of St. George Street, near the labs.
locations.long_description: The atmosphere changes here as you get closer to the engineering and physics buildings. To the West is the Bahen Centre, and to the East is the McLennan Physical Laboratories (MP).

locations.name: Bahen 1F
locations.brief_description: You are on the first floor of the Bahen Center. There are elevators to the West, and an exit from the building to St. George street to the East. You see something shiny on the ground -- looks like a toonie?
locations.long_description: You are on the first floor of the Bahen Center. It's usually crowded at this time of the day, but today it's eerily quiet. Only a few students are studying at the table near the doors. You better not disturb them. One student is rushing down the corridor, wearing a heavy-looking backpack and carrying a textbook in their arms. There are elevators to the West, and an exit from the building to St. George street to the East.

locations.name: Bahen centre
locations.brief_description: You are standing in the front of Bahen centre
locations.long_description: You are standing in the front of Bahen centre

locations.name: Paul's Office
locations.brief_description: You are in the Paul's Office
locations.long_description: You are now in the Paul's Office, Paul is standing there. He loves soving confusion for his students.

locations.name: elevator 1F
locations.brief_description: You are in the elevator 1F
locations.long_description: You are now in the elevator 1F, you can press the button and go to 2F

locations.name: elevator 2F
locations.brief_description: You are on the second floor of the Bahen Center. There are elevators to the West and a lab room
locations.long_description: You are on the second floor of the Bahen Center. It's usually crowded at this time of the day, but today it's eerily quiet. Only a few students are studying at the table near the doors. An empty lecture room. There is an elevator to the West and a locked Lab Room

locations.name: Lecture Room
locations.brief_description: You are in the lecture room
locations.long_description: You are now in the lecture room. There was a student who seemed to be looking for something.

locations.name: Lab Room
locations.brief_description: You are now in front of lab room
locations.long_description: You are now in the lab room. The door lock is a semi-circular opening.Maybe we can put something on to open it?

locations.name: your dorm room
locations.brief_description: This is your room in New College. It's messy but homey.
locations.long_description: You are in your dorm room. There's a desk with your T-card on it and a bed that hasn't been made in days.

locations.name: the door of Study Room
locations.brief_description: You are standing in front of the Study room.
locations.long_description: You can see an upside-down note sticking on the door that says 'push'.It's a Study room in your dorm, however, you cannot enter it even if you push very hard.

locations.name: the Study Room
locations.brief_description: You enter the quiet study room in New College.
locations.long_description: This study room is filled with carrels and heavy silence. You see a computer terminal in the corner. You see your usb drive is left on the table. You keep the door open.

locations.name: New College Lobby
locations.brief_description: You are in the bustling New College Lobby.
locations.long_description: The lobby is busy with students. From here, you can head East to go outside, South toward the Front Desk, or North to your own Room.

locations.name: the Front Desk
locations.brief_description: You are standing in front of New College front desk.
locations.long_description: This is the Front Desk. They have a Lost and Found here. And it is the place to look if you lose your room key. To the North is the lobby, and to the South is the study room.

locations.name: outside New College
locations.brief_description: You are standing in front of the New College building.
locations.long_description: Students are lounging on the nearby benches. Looking around.

locations.name: the Robarts Library
locations.brief_description: You are standing outside the Robarts Library. The entrance is right in front of you. You’ll need a T-Card to enter the building.
locations.long_description: You are standing outside the Robarts Library. Students walk in and out quietly, tapping their T-Cards at the entrance gates. You’ll need a T-Card to enter the building.

locations.name: the Robarts Library 1F
locations.brief_description: You are on the first floor of the Robarts Library. There are elevators to the West, public computers to the East,the bookshelves to the North, and an exit from the building to Huron Street to the South.
locations.long_description: You are on the first floor of the Robarts Library. Students pass by quietly, some heading toward the elevators while others sit at nearby computers. There are elevators to the West, public computers to the East, bookshelves to the North, and an exit from the building to Huron Street to the South.

locations.name: elevators on 1F
locations.brief_description: You are standing in front of the elevators. You can take the elevator up to the second floor.
locations.long_description: You are standing in front of the elevators. A small sign shows that the current floor is the first floor. You can take the elevator up to the second floor.

locations.name: computer area
locations.brief_description: There are many computers. This is a great place to study.
locations.long_description: There are many computers. Many students are working in focused silence. This would be a great place to study—if you had time.

locations.name: book shelves
locations.brief_description: Tall bookshelves surround you. This can be a great place to read books and learn more about how to improve your project.
locations.long_description: Tall bookshelves surround you. This can be a great place to read books and learn more about how to improve your project, but the deadline is creeping closer.

locations.name: elevators on 2F
locations.brief_description: You are standing in front of the elevators. You can take the elevator down to the first floor.
locations.long_description: You are standing in front of the elevators. A small sign shows that the current floor is the second floor. You can take the elevator down to the first floor.

locations.name: the Robarts Library 2F
locations.brief_description: You are on the second floor of the Robarts Library. There are elevators to the West, a study room to the East, and a cafeteria to the North.
locations.long_description: You are on the second floor of the Robarts Library. This floor feels quieter and more focused. There are elevators to the West, a study room to the East, and a cafeteria to the North.

locations.name: study room
locations.brief_description: You are now in the study room.
locations.long_description: You are now in the study room. It is very quiet. A few students are hunched over notebooks and laptops.

locations.name: cafeteria
locations.brief_description: You are now in the cafeteria.
locations.long_description: You are now in the cafeteria. It smells faintly of coffee. A few abandoned cups sit on the tables. Something familiar catches your eye.

locations.name: McLennan Physical Laboratories
locations.brief_description: You are in the front of MP
locations.long_description: You are now in the front of MP. Some classmates came out in a hurry as if they were discussing the hateful calculus.

locations.name: Lecture Room 1
locations.brief_description: This is Lecture Room 1
locations.long_description: You are now in the Lecture Room 1, this room is empty.The blackboard still has the writing from the last class.

locations.name: Lecture Room 2
locations.brief_description: This is Lecture Room 2
locations.long_description: You are now in the Lecture Room 2,you see your classmates are listening attentively (actually just daydreaming)

items.name: toonie
items.description: There is a toonie on the ground. Someone must have dropped it.

items.name: a python reference book
items.description: There is a python reference book left by someone, maybe we can have a look?

items.name: t-card
items.description: Your University of Toronto T-Card. Essential for library access.

items.name: usb drive
items.description: A small black USB drive containing your important course project.

items.name: lucky mug
items.description: Your lucky U of T mug. It has been with you through every late-night study session, every major deadline, and every all-nighter.

items.name: laptop charger
items.description: Your laptop charger.Your classmate was in a hurry to leave and mistakenly took your charging cable.You need to go back to dorm to find socket to charge your laptop.

items.name: left note
items.description: It's a left note by someone. TODO: handle this puzzle

items.name: room key
items.description: It's a spare room key, you can use it to open your room.

NPC.name: The cafeteria staff
NPC.message: Today, a cup of coffee costs 5 yuan. If you bring your own cup, it's free!
NPC.success_message: Oh! You brought your own cup! To show our appreciation for the environmental-conscious students, we can offer you a free cup of coffee.

NPC.name: Your classmates
NPC.message: Sorry, I was in a hurry when leaving and picked up the wrong charging cable for you. Go and get it from the backpack over there.

NPC.name: Front desk staff
NPC.message: If you lose your key, you can come to me~
